meaning: Original unpublished test-first and integration commits are retained locally, grouped into buildable logical publication milestones. Their original hashes identify provenance; canonical published commits use exactly these trees and ordered canonical parents but may have different server metadata. The final documentation/acceptance commit follows these milestones; exact remote mapping belongs to publication verification. No accepted remote history is rewritten.
